Beta build for Minecraft 26.3 - please report anything odd, with `logs/latest.log`.

**Added** Map Style for Dungeon Map (Frost, NA, Odin and LCM looks, with NA Room Text), Show Princes (crowns on prince rooms, with Hide on Kill, Icon Location and Crown Size), Mimic (sends "Mimic Killed!", "Prince Killed!" and "Bat Killed!" to party chat), Key Pickup (on-screen text and a sound when a wither or blood key is picked up), Chat Regex (text and sounds for chat messages you choose, under the renamed QoL column), M5 Shitters (red names and reasons from the M5 Shitters list) and a new Leap Fix based on RSM's.

**Fixed** the blood rush path stopping before the fairy room, the path wandering to the far corner of big rooms, and wither doors sometimes being read as normal doors.

Requires Fabric Loader, Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin and Java 25. Remove any older Frost jar first.

Download `frost-0.4.0-beta.1.jar` below and drop it in your `mods` folder.
